compliance_decision:
1. Accountable institutions must ensure records are unencumbered, readily available to the Centre and relevant supervisory body upon request, reproducible in legible format, and if stored off-site details of third parties providing storage services should be disclosed.
2. Revised Guidance Note (Guideline) 7A – Implementation of various aspects of the FIC Act as per Chunk 11189 from [Source 1: Revised-Guidance-Note-7A-–-Implementation-of-various-aspects-of-the-FIC-Act.txt].

The context specifies that records should be accessible, reproducible in legible format and if off-site storage is used the institution must provide details of third parties storing them; it also advises including reference numbers, dates, issuer or writer's details for record identification purposes as per Chunk 170.
